name: 01-bestand-verfeinert
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Make ONE high-fidelity German website homepage redesign, flat front-on full page, portrait tall canvas about 1440x2600. INPUT IMAGE IS CONTENT REFERENCE: actual existing Long Covid Navigator homepage screenshot. Preserve its REAL TOOLS AND CONCRETE DATA LISTS. This is not a magazine. STRICTLY NO articles, no editorial stories, no 'Artikel lesen', no invented services, no generic content teasers replacing data lists. Design a beautiful lighter version of this exact functional homepage. Use actual site navy #17365d, blue #0878e3, restrained teal #00817d, white, pale blue #f7fafc, fine borders. Clean readable sans-serif. Keep existing LCN compass brand from reference, no new logo. All sections must be visibly present in full-page composition, avoid tiny illegible text.
CONTENT CONTRACT:
1 Header LCN, nav 'Empfehlung', 'Hausärzte', 'Suche', 'Ergänzen', 'Über das Projekt'.
2 Landscape hero from reference or tastefully recompose it. Exact headline 'Wir helfen dir auf deinem Weg zur Genesung.' and short subline 'Für Menschen mit Long Covid, ME/CFS und POTS.' Small quick links 'Empfehlung', 'Hausärzte', 'Suche', 'Ergänzen'.
3 'Empfehlung' / 'Unsere redaktionellen Top-Einträge'. TWO SIDE-BY-SIDE REAL CATALOG LIST PANELS MUST HAVE ALL TEN ENTRIES EACH. Left 'Therapien im Fokus', table columns Therapie, Behandler; exact ten rows with provider counts: 'Low-Dose Naltrexon (LDN)' 12; 'Pacing' 21; 'Ivabradin' 4; 'Erhöhte Salzaufnahme' 3; 'Erhöhte Flüssigkeitszufuhr' 3; 'Hyperbare Sauerstofftherapie (HBOT)' 4; 'H.E.L.P.-Apherese' 5; 'Therapeutischer Plasmaaustausch (TPE)' 4; 'Immunadsorption' 5; 'N-Acetylcystein (NAC)' 3. Footer button 'Top-Therapien ansehen'. Right 'Behandler im Fokus', columns Behandler, Ort, Therapien; ten exact rows: 'Dr. Michael Stingl' Wien 64; 'Prof. Dr. Carmen Scheibenbogen' Berlin 3; 'Dr. Michael Kacik' Münster 109; 'Dr. Beate Jaeger' Mülheim 4; 'Dr. Maja Strasser' Solothurn 172; 'Dr. Bettina Hohberger' Erlangen 3; 'Dr. Valentina Puntmann' Frankfurt 6; 'Prof. Dr. Uta Behrends' München 4; 'Dr. Herbert Renz-Polster' Rottweil 1; 'Dr. Kristina Schultheiß' Immenstadt 32. Footer 'Top-Behandler ansehen'. These numbers represent catalog relationships not ratings. No star ratings. Small note 'Redaktionelle Auswahl – kein Wirksamkeitsranking.' First three entries can be highlighted cards, remaining seven compact table rows, or all ten clean rows.
4 FULL REAL HOUSE-DOCTOR TOOL under title 'Hausärztliche Versorgung'. Subline 'Schau nach, ob deine Hausarztpraxis schon dabei ist. Falls sie fehlt, ergänze sie.' Labeled 'Dein Ausgangsort', field 'Adresse, PLZ oder Ort eingeben', action 'Anlaufstellen finden'. Then Germany map WITH BLUE PINS plus adjacent scrollable list of actual reference practices: 'Arke Dixon · Hamburg', 'Benjamin Seliger · Halle (Saale)', 'Görte Bertram · München', 'Dr. Adrian Knispel · Mölln', 'Dr. Andreas Grothusen · Hamburg'. Button 'Hausärztliche Suche öffnen'. Separate strip 'Deine Hausarztpraxis fehlt?' / 'Praxis ergänzen'. Do not replace map tool with mere link; map AND results must stay.
5 'Suche' two equal destination cards 'Therapien suchen' / 'Therapien entdecken' and 'Behandler finden' / 'Fachbehandler finden'. These open existing filtered catalog/map tools, NOT a new global search field. No invented search filter interface.
6 ADD a dedicated row 'Eintrag ergänzen' with two distinct cards/buttons 'Behandlung ergänzen', 'Behandler ergänzen'; subline 'Fehlt eine Behandlung oder eine Anlaufstelle? Schlage einen Eintrag vor.' This is submitting catalog entries, NOT writing articles or submitting an experience review.
7 Short 'Über das Projekt' with 'Die Herausforderung', 'Unsere Vision', 'Wo wir gerade stehen', then 'Projektstatus' and 'Medizinischer Hinweis'. Footer links 'Startseite · Ärzte/Behandler · Therapien · Datenschutz · Impressum'.
No other sections or factual promises. Catalog numbers and names transcribed from reference screenshot, not invented. Visual variation instruction: BESTAND VERFEINERT. Keep exact current section order hero > recommendations > house-doctor map > search > new contribution > project. Modern airy white foundation, subtle landscape hero, navy heading, muted teal tiny highlights. Ten-item lists each with three distinct compact top cards and seven small rows. Replace heavy blue areas with thin rules and subtle pale surfaces. 40px section rhythm. Label outside webpage '01 / Bestand verfeinert'.
